Meanwhile, when Fred arrives at their apartment to welcome Jane home, Stacy is disappointed to see him with his new girlfriend. So after consulting relationship guru Nikki LePree, Stacy tells Fred that she still has feelings for him, only to be rejected once again. When Emily confesses to killing Troy after he threatened to release a video of them having sex, Jane suspects she's using her newly granted immunity in order to help her husband avoid prosecution. And after evidence supporting Anton's alibi forces the judge to dismiss the charges, Jane realizes that she's been duped into helping the Horns get away with murder. Meanwhile, after learning of the misunderstanding, Fred has a change of heart only to find that Stacy has moved on.

programme.desc: Dokumentar om en af de største kontroverser i svensk kulturliv: hvordan en nobelpris bliver en personlig tragedie for to af Sveriges mest indflydelsesrige forfattere. I 1974 tildeles Harry Martinson og Eyvind Johnson Nobelprisen i litteratur. To autodidakte arbejderklasseforfattere, der er gået fra samfundets bund til medlemmer af Det Kongelige Svenska Akademi. Men prisen vækker vrede, og beskyldninger om korruption rettes mod Det Svenske Akademi for at belønne sine egne. En mediestorm bryder ud, og tonen er hård. Mest ramt bliver Harry og Eyvind selv, som bliver kritiseret og udspurgt. Deres sidste leveår er tynget af skuffelse, fortvivlelse og sygdom.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Uppsala
programme.desc: Uppsala is the city of knowledge: home to the oldest university in Scandinavia. It’s a wonderful agricultural area surrounded by fertile flatlands. Tareq discovers the historical treasures of Uppsala and its thriving culinary life.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Sealand
programme.desc: North Zealand has been a playground of the rich and famous since the fifteenth century. Tareq learns how this beautiful north eastern part of Denmark is the perfect place to go foraging for wild berries and herbs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åre
programme.desc: Sweden’s largest ski resort Åre is well known for its local ingredients, boasting the highest number of organic food producers per capita in Sweden. The fresh water and clean air create unique conditions for growing excellent food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Danish Lakelands
programme.desc: The Danish Lakelands produce some of the finest ingredients that you can find. Tareq has a go at an old cooking technique from New Zealand called Hangi - using heated rocks buried in a pit oven.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Gothenburg on the west coast of Sweden has recently been discovered as an exciting destination by both international travel journalists and food bloggers. Tareq tracks down an old army barracks which has been converted into a world class cheese factory.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Luleå
programme.desc: Tareq visits Luleå, home to the beautiful Tree Hotel: a collection of treehouses built by an award winning architect. Following the river further up into the mountains he reaches the land where, for centuries, the Sami people kept their reindeer herds.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Halmstad
programme.desc: In Halmstad Tareq explores the contrast between the busy summer scene at the beach and the quiet rural country life, meeting Jörgen Persson: award winning table tennis player and visiting a village famous for its cheese.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kemi
programme.desc: Kemi is situated in northern Finland by the Bothnian Bay and it is part of Lapland region. Tareq tries his luck at a spot of burbot fishing on the frozen sea and visits the snow castle hotel.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Situated on the west coast of Sweden, Bohuslän is a place where you can really feel the history of fishing all around a tradition that is still active. Tareq will be harvesting supreme quality oysters and lobsters and cook some wonderful seafood dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Florø
programme.desc: Tareq visits Norway and Florø to celebrate their national day -17th of May. Surrounded by breathtaking archipelagos and stunning fjords he dives for scallops in the north sea, cooking at mountain peaks and exploring the history of norwegian salmon

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia
programme.desc: Tareq makes his way across the baltic sea to Estonia and the capital Tallinn. He discovers the historical treasures of the city and its thriving culinary life before he heads out into the vast and beautiful countryside and the national park of Soomaa.

programme.desc: Ringkøbing, a lovely old market town located at the west coast of Denmark. Here, Tareq visit a traditional Herring Festival and meets up with local entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever-changing environment.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Falkenberg
programme.desc: Something is definitely happening in Falkenberg on the west coast of Sweden. Over the last couple of years it have become somewhat of a haven for foodies. Tareq is on a mission; taking him through a fertile landscape with vineyards and salmon fishing.

programme.title: The Hills: You Know What You Did
programme.desc: Lauren går ikke til Heidi and Spencers housewarming fordi Heidi har spredt rygter om hende. Så da Lauren løber ind i Heidi har de et kæmpe skænderi.

programme.desc: Lauren og Heidi bliver endnu mere uvenner da Spencer frier til Heidi. Audrina finder sammen med en ekskæreste og Lauren vender hjem til Laguna Beach for at få et godt råd.

programme.desc: Lauren prøver at hjælpe Audrina med at beslutte om Justin har kærestekvalitet, men Audrina har allerede truffet sin beslutning. Heidi finder ud af, at det ikke er lutter lagkage at være forlovet.

programme.title: The Hills: Meet The Parents
programme.desc: Ifølge mig: et komisk twist på din yndlings reality-serie. Fra Lauren til Spencer og alle de andre, intet bitchy look eller bromance udelades af skuespilleren, der spilleralle de medvirkende.

programme.desc: Heidis sociale omgangskreds krymper da Spencer 'slår op' med Brody fordi han har hængt ud med Lauren. Audrina vil være fast kæreste med Justin, men det nægter han at gå med til.

programme.title: The Hills: For Better Or Worse
programme.desc: Lauren bliver chokeret da hun hører, at Jason har en kæreste, men Jason har en endnu større overraskelse oppe i ærmet. Heidi finder ud af at Spencer ikke har fortalt sine forældre om deres bryllupsplaner.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Dosage
programme.desc: Toxicology: While drugs can cure disease and ease pain, they can also be agents of murder. Toxicologists can examine blood and tissue to uncover cases where death is not as natural as it may seemfrom slow arsenic poisoning to quick cocaine overdoses.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tools Of Death
programme.desc: Tool marking: A tool used to commit a crime can often be the same tool used to solve it. The pattern a machine leaves on an item, the unusual way a tool crimps a wire, and even something as innocuous as the shape of a wood chip can lead to a killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out Of The Grave
programme.desc: New Forensic Techniques used to Solve Old Cases: Advancement in science and technology are encouraging people to revisit the past in hopes of answering questions that have remained unanswered, and solving crimes that seemed unsolvable.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Infallible Witness
programme.desc: Investigators are always on the cutting edge of new forensic techniques that can help them solve cases more accurately. An experimental "brain fingerprinting" technique has already won the acquittal of a police officer accused of a drug charge.

programme.title: The New Detectives: From The Ashes
programme.desc: Arson Investigation: Insurance torchings, mob burnouts and arson murders: these crimes are designed to take all clues with them. But a solid case can be built from a heap of ashes.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Living In Terror
programme.desc: Terrorism: Thanks to new technology and, perhaps, the approaching millennium, terrorism is a growing international threat. The Oklahoma City explosion and the bombing of the World Trade Center are just two of the incidents of this growing problem.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Obsessions
programme.desc: Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Traces Of Guilt
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence: a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Electronic Witness
programme.desc: George Orwell's concept of Big Brother remains in the realm of fiction. But as technology becomes more a part of our lives, it's becoming increasingly more difficult to make a move without leaving behind an electronic trace.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Wrong
programme.desc: Hiding a body can be difficult; it's sometimes easier to obscure or disguise the circumstances of the death, turning murder into suicide, or pinning the blame on someone else. The truth is told through subtle clues taken from the crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Wrong

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lasting Impressions
programme.desc: No matter how chaotic or how clean a crime scene appears to be, the culprit is bound to leave something telling behind. Occasionally, it's nothing more than a fingerprint or shoe tread. Sometimes that's all that's needed.

programme.desc: Jayden spiser 150 limstifter om ugen. Terry skjuler en livslang vane med at spise pap. Charlotte har ingen planer om at stoppe med at amme sine børn.

programme.desc: De sidste syv deltagere skal håndtere en "mystery box" fyldt med hvidløg - og en anden ingrediens, som først afsløres 30 minutter inde i udfordringen.

programme.title: MasterChef Australia

programme.title: Simpsons
programme.desc: Som vinder af 2019 Emmy® Award-prisen for fremragende, animeret program fortsætter The Simpsons med at vække genklang hos seere for uærbødigt at lave sjov med alt og alle. Med dens yderliggående humor og herlige vid har serien gjort et uudsletteligt indtryk på amerikansk popkultur, og dets familiemedlemmer: Homer (Dan Castellaneta), Marge (Julie Kavner), Bart (Nancy Cartwright), Lisa (Yeardley Smith) og Maggie: er tv-ikoner. Som den længst kørende, nedskrevne serie i tv-historien har den Emmy® Award-, Annie Award- og Peabody Award-vindende, animerede komedie overgået Gunsmokes rekord for flest episoder af en nedskrevet, primetime tv-serie. The Simpsons er en Gracie Films produktion i samarbejde med 20th Century Fox Television. Serien blev skabt af Matt Groening og udviklet af James L. Brooks, Matt Groening og Sam Simon. James L. Brooks og Matt Groening er executive producere. Al Jean og Matt Selman er også executive producere og seriens showrunners.
